text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syrian Vice President Abdel-Halim Khaddam carries a letter from President Hafez al-assad to Chinese President Jiang Zemin.
- Lebanon stresses coordination of policies with Syria in peace process.
- Arabs to coordinate policies in the financial, political, social and economic issues to be discussed in forthcoming EU-Mediterranean conference.
